verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit lets users define rule-based automation that fires on events: auto-review settings can be enabled/disabled by keyword/label, restricted to branches, or paused after N commits (coderabbit-docs-21); path-based and AST-grep pattern instructions apply targeted rules automatically during reviews (coderabbit-docs-8, coderabbit-docs-9); and one-click 'agentic actions' can auto-fix findings, resolve conflicts, or run custom recipes (coderabbit-docs-13). This covers rule-triggered automation within the code-review domain but not a general-purpose event/rule engine for arbitrary actions outside review workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these automation rules working reliably in practice, and evidence of broader event-trigger scope (e.g., webhooks/custom triggers beyond PR/branch/label events).
